items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was Benny Payne on piano, Morris White on guitar, Leroy Maxey on drums, and I was on bass. Now, you name a section. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, the saxophones had Hilton Jefferson...

ctx.x: Now, who is there? Lamar Wright was there...
